facts.full: OVERHEARD AT THE BOOTH / Parting your soup is not a miracle, Bruce, it's a magic trick. / God
facts.why: The line is God's, but he says it near the end in the white warehouse room while mopping the floor, not at the diner booth. At the diner God only sits opposite Bruce and asks 'Having fun?'.

fix_note.text: Parting your soup is not a miracle, Bruce, it's a magic trick.

facts.applied_text: OVERHEARD WHILE MOPPING / Parting your soup is not a miracle, Bruce, it's a magic trick. / God

facts.text: Overheard at the counter: Evan's teleprompter cha-cha.
facts.why: Evan's cha-cha gibberish happens live on air at the TV studio when Bruce works the teleprompter, not at a diner counter.
facts.fix: On the TV over the counter: Evan's cha-cha.
facts.applied_text: On the TV over the counter: Evan's cha-cha.

facts.text: The booth where Bruce parts his tomato soup.
facts.why: The still above the caption shows a shirtless Bruce against the sky, not the diner booth, so the caption describes a different scene from the picture.
facts.fix: Bruce Almighty, trying out the powers.
facts.applied_text: Bruce Almighty, trying out the powers.

vibe.verdict: The soup parting and the Sabres land, but the diner is an invented name, the prime rib hangs on one teleprompter word, and the house pickles print a 5.95 price under 'Free with every miracle'.
